name: Gojo social card by Gojo
description: A 1200×630 social card uses a heavily blurred, warm-toned background image as an atmospheric full-bleed canvas, with amber, rust, olive and charcoal areas blending into one another. The focal stack is centered: a white abstract mark sits above a large rounded wordmark, followed by a smaller one-line tagline; generous vertical spacing and strong white contrast keep the hierarchy legible over the soft imagery.
